name: Florence
source:
Florence is the protagonist of Messy Hearts. They're a parent and they deeply love the people in their life.

They are ENM, going through a breakup, and caught off guard when a safe-seeming coworker gives them a lot of attention.

Challenges include: OCD, CPTSD, anxiety, and low self-esteem.
